scenarios.title: Pre-departure readiness review
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate traceable review of configuration, people, environment and critical system readiness before a planned departure.
preconditions: approved vessel-specific departure procedure is available
weather, route and port information source is identified
vessel-instance configuration and equipment status are verified outside this reference example

steps.action: Confirm scenario applicability and approved procedure identity.
steps.completion_criteria: Applicable vessel-specific procedure is positively identified.

steps.action: Report readiness evidence and unresolved discrepancies for assigned systems.
steps.completion_criteria: Evidence and unknowns are recorded without treating missing data as ready.

steps.action: Decide whether to proceed, defer or abort according to approved procedure and judgement.
steps.completion_criteria: Human decision and rationale are recorded.

hazards.description: Unknown or missing evidence is misinterpreted as satisfactory readiness.
hazards.safeguard: Unknown values block automatic positive conclusions and require human resolution.

scenarios.title: Navigation information degradation
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate escalation and evidence handling when one or more navigation data sources become unavailable, stale or conflicting.
preconditions: available independent observations can be distinguished from inferred values

trigger.description: Navigation source is unavailable, stale, implausible or conflicts with another source.

steps.action: Present source identity, timestamp, quality and conflict without selecting a command action.
steps.completion_criteria: Degraded source and uncertainty are visible.

steps.action: Assess available evidence and choose the applicable approved degraded-mode response.
steps.completion_criteria: Human decision, evidence basis and restrictions are recorded.

hazards.description: Stale or conflicting data is treated as current and authoritative.
hazards.safeguard: Freshness, source and quality remain visible; inferred data cannot overwrite observed source records.

stop_conditions: position or traffic situation cannot be assessed

scenarios.title: Water-ingress alert response boundary
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate emergency scenario structure, alert provenance and human escalation without prescribing vessel-specific actions.
preconditions: approved vessel-specific emergency procedure is available
crew roles and communication method are established
alert source identity and confidence can be recorded

trigger.description: Potential unintended water ingress is indicated.

steps.action: Raise an advisory alert with source, time, quality and affected reference entity.
steps.completion_criteria: Alert provenance and uncertainty are visible.

steps.action: Take command of response under the approved vessel-specific emergency procedure.
steps.completion_criteria: Command authority and applicable procedure are confirmed.

steps.action: Report observations and actions through the command structure defined by the approved procedure.
steps.completion_criteria: Reports remain traceable to actor, time and evidence source.

hazards.description: Absence or clearance of an electronic alert is interpreted as proof that ingress is absent.
hazards.safeguard: Electronic state is advisory; human assessment and approved procedure remain authoritative.

hazards.description: Reference scenario is mistaken for an approved emergency procedure.
hazards.safeguard: Scenario contains no vessel-specific action sequence and explicitly requires approved procedure.

stop_conditions: reference scenario could delay approved emergency action
